_note: r.164(3)(l): "is a person in whose case tax has been deducted under section 393(3) [Table : Sl No. 5]". s.393(3) Table Sl. 5: any sum paid in cash from one or more accounts, by a banking company, a co-operative society carrying on banking or a post office, 2%, above three crore rupees for a co-operative society recipient or one crore rupees for any other. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27 (W-090d, D-652 G1a): for TY 2025-26 it is Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (VII), "section 194N" (Income-tax Rules, 1962, kept live by r.164(14)); the question names no section, so one wording serves both years.
question: Did a bank, co-operative bank or post office deduct tax on cash you withdrew from your accounts during the tax year?
